preprocessing.description: Exactly 512 finite observations in oldest-to-newest recording order. The exported graph preserves Chronos-Bolt's native scaling and missing-value handling; callers must not apply target-specific normalization.

producer.description: Export a fixed 512-value context and select only the 0.5 quantile at the first forecast horizon inside the portable graph. Native target variants must preserve that exact scalar meaning.

evaluation.description: Minimum held-out improvement over repeating the newest observation on the user's time-ordered telemetry.
Maximum scalar difference between pinned-source and portable-graph outputs on frozen finite contexts.
No NaN or infinite scalar forecast is accepted.

tpu.reason: Needs portable wrapper export, representative fully-int8 calibration, full Edge TPU mapping, semantic parity and Coral execution evidence.

npu.reason: Needs portable wrapper export, OpenVINO conversion, semantic parity and execution evidence on the named NPU.

gpu.reason: Needs portable wrapper export, ncnn conversion, semantic parity and execution evidence on the named GPU.
